name: Black Tides Draga's Wake
storyline: A new era of survival horror arrives with Black Tides: Draga's Wake. Step into the boots of Draga, a hardened smuggler and pirate first mate whose ultimate heist has gone catastrophically wrong. Trapped aboard the Ormora—a decaying 1900s steamship icelocked in unpredictable waters—you must navigate a labyrinth of iron to find your missing crew while fighting a losing battle against the ritualistic, cosmic horrors that have breached our reality.
summary: Clinging to his fading humanity, he must survive the nightmare he is becoming. Black Tides Draga’s Wake is a visceral third-person action horror-adventure set in an alternate 1900s where ancient Gods and vessels of steam and steel collide. Find your crew, escape the horrors within, or die trying..
